zh.title: 任务状态以结构化信号为准
items: Web 和电脑端 Relay 不再根据标题中的“进行中”“运行中”等文字推断任务状态。
只有 Agent 返回的结构化 active 状态才会把任务标记为运行中；idle、notLoaded 或缺少状态的任务不会被标题误判。
跨进程工具活动仍会正常同步，但不会因此篡改任务的运行状态。

en.title: Task status follows structured signals
items: The Web app and desktop Relay no longer infer task state from labels such as Running or In progress in a title.
Only the Agent's structured active status marks a task as running; idle, notLoaded, and missing states cannot be overridden by a title.
Cross-process tool activity continues to sync without changing the task's authoritative runtime state.
